claim: TrailRun TR does not pay compensation for delays, such as vouchers or cash, apart from the free re-shipment or refund.
answer: No, TrailRun TR does not pay compensation for delays or trouble, such as vouchers or cash, apart from the free re-shipment or refund if a parcel is declared lost [1], [4].

passages.label: 1] [SHP-003 §4
passages.text:
Delayed and Lost Parcel Escalation (Yurtiçi and Aras Kargo) — §4 No other compensation
Apart from the free re-shipment or refund in §3, TrailRun TR does not pay compensation for delays, such as vouchers or cash. Claims against the carrier are handled by TrailRun TR, not by the customer.

passages.label: 2] [SHP-003 §5
passages.text:
Delayed and Lost Parcel Escalation (Yurtiçi and Aras Kargo) — §5 Delivered but not received
If tracking says "delivered" but the customer has not received the parcel, the customer should report it within 48 hours. Support opens a carrier investigation.

passages.label: 3] [SHP-003 §2
passages.text:
Delayed and Lost Parcel Escalation (Yurtiçi and Aras Kargo) — §2 Escalation after 3 business days
If a parcel has **no carrier scan for more than 3 business days**, support escalates it to the carrier and asks for a trace. The customer is told the case number.

passages.label: 4] [SHP-003 §3
passages.text:
Delayed and Lost Parcel Escalation (Yurtiçi and Aras Kargo) — §3 Declared lost after 7 business days
If a parcel has **no scan for 7 business days**, it is declared lost. TrailRun TR **re-ships the order free of charge**, or refunds it if the item is out of stock. The customer does not have to wait for the carrier's own investigation.

passages.label: 5] [SHP-003 §1
passages.text:
Delayed and Lost Parcel Escalation (Yurtiçi and Aras Kargo) — §1 Normal gaps
A parcel can show no new scan for 1–2 business days while it moves between hubs. This is normal and needs no action.

claim: You can use your tracking number to ask the carrier directly to redirect the parcel to one of its branches.
answer: Once the parcel is handed to the carrier (status `IN_TRANSIT`), TrailRun TR cannot change the address or cancel the shipment [3]. However, you can use your tracking number to ask the carrier directly to redirect the parcel to one of its branches [3].

passages.label: 1] [SHP-004 §1
passages.text:
Address Changes and Cancellations After Dispatch — §1 Before dispatch
While an order has status `PROCESSING`, the customer can change the delivery address or cancel the order free of charge through support.

passages.label: 2] [SHP-004 §3
passages.text:
Address Changes and Cancellations After Dispatch — §3 Refusing delivery
A customer who no longer wants a dispatched order can refuse delivery. The order is refunded when the parcel returns to our warehouse, minus the original shipping fee.

passages.label: 3] [SHP-004 §2
passages.text:
Address Changes and Cancellations After Dispatch — §2 After dispatch
Once the parcel is handed to the carrier (status `IN_TRANSIT`), TrailRun TR **cannot change the address or cancel the shipment**. The customer can ask the carrier directly to redirect the parcel to one of its branches using the tracking number.

passages.label: 4] [SHP-001 §5
passages.text:
Domestic Shipping, Cutoffs and Free-Shipping Threshold — §5 Tracking
Tracking updates come from the carrier. Support can see the same scans as the customer; we cannot change a carrier's delivery date.

passages.label: 5] [SHP-004 §4
passages.text:
Address Changes and Cancellations After Dispatch — §4 Identity checks
Address changes are only made after the customer's identity is checked as described in `SOP-004`.

answer: For bank transfer payments, the refund typically takes 2–5 business days to arrive in the account that paid after it is issued [1].

passages.text:

A refund is issued after the returned item is inspected at our warehouse, usually within 2 business days of arrival. The customer receives an email when the refund is issued.

passages.text:

passages.label: 4] [POL-004 §3
passages.text:

passages.label: 5] [POL-006 §5
passages.text:

A defect reported more than 7 days after delivery is not a transit claim. It is reviewed under the 2-year manufacturing warranty (`WAR-001`, or `WAR-004` for watches), which can lead to repair or replacement but not a refund.

claim: If you are using the Express Same-Day Istanbul Courier option, orders must be placed before 12:00.
answer: For standard domestic shipping, orders placed before 14:00 on a business day are dispatched the same day [1]. If you are using the Express Same-Day Istanbul Courier option, orders must be placed before 12:00 [2].

passages.label: 1] [SHP-001 §2
passages.text:

Orders placed before **14:00 on a business day** are dispatched the same day. Orders placed after 14:00, or on weekends and public holidays, are dispatched the next business day.

passages.label: 2] [SHP-002 §2
passages.text:
Express Same-Day Istanbul Courier — §2 Cutoff and cost
Orders placed before **12:00** with the Express option are delivered the same day between 17:00 and 22:00. The Express fee is 149 TRY and is charged even when the order qualifies for free standard shipping.

passages.label: 3] [SHP-001 §3
passages.text:
Domestic Shipping, Cutoffs and Free-Shipping Threshold — §3 Delivery time
Standard delivery takes 1–3 business days after dispatch in most cities, and up to 5 business days for rural areas.

passages.label: 4] [SHP-002 §1
passages.text:
Express Same-Day Istanbul Courier — §1 Where it is available
Same-day courier delivery is available for addresses inside Istanbul only, on business days.

passages.label: 5] [SHP-002 §4
passages.text:
Express Same-Day Istanbul Courier — §4 Race-week tip
Before big races, Express slots fill early. Support cannot reserve a slot or guarantee a delivery time beyond what the checkout shows.

claim: You have 30 calendar days from the delivery date to return an item
answer: You have 30 calendar days from the delivery date to return an item [1]. The return window starts on the day the carrier records the parcel as delivered, not the order date [1]. Day 1 of the return window is the day after delivery [1].

passages.label: 1] [POL-001 §1
passages.text:
Standard 30-Day Return Policy — §1 Return window
Items bought from TrailRun TR can be returned within **30 calendar days of the delivery date**. The delivery date is the date the carrier records the parcel as delivered, not the order date. Day 1 is the day after delivery, and a return requested on day 30 is still inside the window. A request on day 31 or later is outside the window.

passages.label: 2] [POL-001 §2
passages.text:
Standard 30-Day Return Policy — §2 What counts as a return request
A return request is opened when the customer contacts support with the order number (`ORD-YYYY-XXXX`) and the item (`SKU-...`) they want to return. The request date, not the date the parcel reaches our warehouse, is what we compare with the 30-day window.

passages.label: 3] [POL-004 §3
passages.text:
Final-Sale and Clearance Exclusions — §3 Defective on arrival
A `FINAL-SALE` item that arrives damaged or defective can be returned. Report it within 7 days of delivery as described in `POL-006`. The `FINAL-SALE` exclusion does not apply to defects on arrival.

passages.label: 4] [POL-001 §5
passages.text:
Standard 30-Day Return Policy — §5 Items reported as defective
An item that arrives damaged or defective follows `POL-006` (report within 7 days of delivery). A defect found after normal use is not a return; it is reviewed under the 2-year manufacturing warranty in `WAR-001`.

passages.label: 5] [POL-001 §4
passages.text:

claim: FINAL-SALE items are non-returnable and non-refundable for any reason other than a defect on arrival
answer: `FINAL-SALE` items are non-returnable and non-refundable for any reason other than a defect on arrival [2]. No staff member or manager can make an exception to this rule, and a promise made by phone does not make a `FINAL-SALE` item returnable [1]. Specifically, a `FINAL-SALE` jacket where a customer claims a manager promised a return after 60 days is not eligible for return [3].

passages.label: 1] [POL-004 §4
passages.text:

Customers who believe they were misinformed can ask for a human review, but the review applies this policy.

passages.text:
